features.description: Base web extruded .88 normal to Right plane. Coordinates u=Right-view horizontal, v=height, x=Front-view horizontal thickness direction. Unchamfered side profile spans u=0..4.26, v=1..5, with lower extension u=2.51..4.26, v=0..1. Thickness x=0.. .88.
Flange over u=2.51..4.26, v=0..5. Add 1.37 thickness to web, reaching x=2.25. Rear plane u=4.26 is datum A.
Lower width step: remove x=1.50..2.25, v=0.. .75, through flange depth u=2.51..4.26.
Tongue projecting .12 beyond A, .749 high. Interpreted nominal u=4.26..4.38, v=2.626..3.375, across overall thickness width. Confirm attachment of .375/.749 dimensions before machining.
.750 +.001/-.000 through bore normal to Right view, through .88 web, at (u,v)=(1.26,3).

Three .250-20 internal threads, .50 tapped depth, class unspecified.

Two blind tap preparations normal to Right view, entering stepped x=1.50 face. Centers (u,v)=(2.885,.375),(3.885,.375). Drill diameters/depths unspecified.

MAX. R. callouts .03 and .06 are limits, not unique nominal fillet radii.
Three small holes approximate a .750-radius 120° pattern. Rectangular dimensions control: .750 left, .375 right, ±.650 vertical. Exact 120° construction would yield .649519 rather than printed .650.

Derived dimensions have no independent manufacturing tolerances; retain original controlling dimensions and tolerance stackups.
Angular value 45 and tolerance 1 are degrees despite the schema's required linear-unit enumeration.
Perpendicularity frame is in legacy order perpendicularity | A | .001. Branched leaders interpreted as opposing thickness-direction faces; verify exact inspection-face association on original.
